mission: Crypto Research V3 — BTC-Residual Low-Variance Validation

pit_semantics.description: configured 22-symbol candidate pool ∩ bars available at date t → CryptoUniverseScanner → eligible PIT pool → candidate strategy ranking
pit_semantics.production_scanner: CryptoUniverseScanner with production config (same as PAPER)
pit_semantics.aggregation: 1h -> 1d via aggregate_historical_bars with require_complete=True; only COMPLETE daily bars; missing data = unavailable; no forward-fill; no interpolation
pit_semantics.exclusion_rule: MKR/USD, NEAR/USD, TRX/USD must never enter eligible pool even if bars exist; enforced by allowed_crypto_pool filter in backtest/universe.py

control.name: crypto_low_variance_v2
control.signal_formula: r_i,t = P_i,t / P_i,t-1 - 1; sigma_i = sample_std(r_i over last 22 daily returns); require 23 consecutive completed daily bars spanning exactly 22 calendar days; rank ascending sigma_i; select top 2 equal pre-risk weight

factor_model.regression: r_i,t = alpha_i + beta_i * r_BTC,t + epsilon_i,t via OLS with intercept over trailing window
factor_model.candidate_score: sigma_resid_i = sample_std(epsilon_i over residual_vol_window) with n-1
factor_model.ranking: ascending sigma_resid_i; deterministic tie-break by symbol name
factor_model.timestamp_alignment: BTC and coin returns must be timestamp-aligned on same daily bar timestamps; no interpolation; missing BTC observation invalidates that date for that coin

btc_special_handling.chosen_option: A with clarification — BTC remains eligible; BTC residual score = BTC total realized volatility (sample_std of BTC daily returns over 22d). Regressing BTC on itself is prohibited (would produce near-zero residual and force BTC first). Documented as preferred default per §4.
btc_special_handling.alternative_considered: Option B (exclude BTC) rejected; Option A selected
btc_special_handling.rationale: regressing BTC on itself produces meaningless near-zero residual variance and would force BTC to rank first artificially

requirements: all regression observations must end at decision time t with only completed bars
coin must have complete required observations (beta_window + residual window alignment)
fail safely when regression invalid: huge beta, near-zero BTC variance, singular alignment, insufficient samples, non-finite residuals — no silent zero-beta substitution

parameters.btc_handling: BTC total vol used for both ranks
parameters.weights: equal, no learned weights, no optimization

R3_RESIDUAL_CONSENSUS.purpose: combine short and stable beta estimates without optimization

requirements: coin must have complete required observations
independent arithmetic unit tests with hand-computable series vs independent calculation

expected_assumptions.note: authoritative values from config/settings.yaml backtest.crypto_taker_fee_bps/slippage_bps/spread_bps; if harness defines different, record actual effective values in every result

full_window.warmup: 2021-01-01 to 2021-03-31 (at least 63d for R2 beta + 22d vol; earliest viable decision ~2021-03-04 buffered to 04-01)
full_window.rationale: dataset starts 2021-01-01; 63d beta window requires ~2021-03-04 earliest decision; 04-01 start ensures all candidates have full warmup including scanner 14d lookback

folds.note: truncated to dataset end; reported but excluded from 60%-beat gate denominator unless explicitly stated

each_fold_requirements: have its own warmup (bars before fold start used only for warmup, not evaluated)
calculate beta only using data available before/at decision time

regime_definition.note: predefined before results; do not choose thresholds after results; if project has canonical BTC regime, prefer canonical but document which is used; here using suggested 126d return thresholds
regime_definition.requirement: performance must not derive essentially all value from one isolated regime

attribution: top contributor share of positive PnL
jackknife_required: plus top candidate-specific positive contributor if different
concentration_jackknife.full_22_leave_one_out: not required unless cheap; at minimum the 3-4 above
concentration_jackknife.question: Does candidate remain directionally positive without its largest contributor?
concentration_jackknife.fragile_if: one coin explains most of edge

turnover_analysis.comparison: R1-R3 vs CONTROL; modest gross improvement not attractive if turnover explodes and net improvement disappears

for_R1_R3_report: fraction of candidates with insufficient aligned BTC history
fraction rejected for missing consecutive data
beta_residual_diagnostics.failure_mode: fail candidate safely when regression is invalid; no silent zero-beta substitution

promotion_gates.note: ALL 12 must pass to label VALIDATED CANDIDATE. Do not weaken after seeing results.

gates.description: Full-window CAGR > CONTROL OR materially lower maxDD with comparable CAGR
Walk-forward: positive folds >= CONTROL positive folds AND median fold return >= CONTROL median fold return
Candidate beats CONTROL in >= 60% of comparable folds (≥6/9)
3x cost stress is not catastrophic (defined as maxDD not > 2x control maxDD and CAGR not < -5% annualized; or more strictly, not wiping out >75% of 1x gross edge)
No single symbol explains > 50% of total positive PnL unless leave-one-out still remains attractive (Sharpe and CAGR still > control ex-that-symbol)
Remove-largest-contributor test remains directionally positive (net return > 0 and Sharpe > 0)
No single 6-month fold explains most of total excess return (>50% of total window PnL from one fold)
Turnover increase is economically justified (net Sharpe after costs still > control, and turnover increase < 2x unless net improvement > 20% Sharpe uplift)
Performance is not exclusively one BTC regime (positive net return in at least 2 of BULL/NEUTRAL/BEAR)
No research/PAPER universe parity violation (hash_point_in_time_universe uses configured ∩ bar availability; no MKR/NEAR/TRX in selected history)

rejection_gates.note: Any gate failure → REJECTED or WEAK per classification; WEAK not promoted

classification.STRONG: clear improvement in full window + WF + robustness + costs
classification.MODERATE: smaller but consistent improvement with acceptable robustness
classification.WEAK: marginal / concentrated / regime-sensitive improvement → NOT PROMOTED
